question: From 2003, which teams lost successive World Cup finals? Mention the team name and the years of these matches.
query: WITH finals AS (SELECT match_id, match_date, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1 ELSE 'New Zealand' END AS losing_team, CAST(strftime('%Y', match_date) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final') SELECT f1.losing_team AS team_name, f1.year AS year1, f2.year AS year2 FROM finals f1 JOIN finals f2 ON f1.losing_team = f2.losing_team AND f2.year = f1.year + 4 ORDER BY team_name;
question_english: From 2003, which teams lost successive World Cup finals? Mention the team name and the years of these matches.
question_hindi: 2003 से, किन टीमों ने लगातार विश्व कप फाइनल हारे? टीम का नाम और उन मैचों के वर्ष बताएं।
question_punjabi: 2003 ਤੋਂ, ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਹਾਰੀਆਂ? ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: 2003 నుంచి ఏ టిములు వరుసగా వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఫినల్స్ ఓడిపోయారు? టీం యొక్క పేరు మరియు మ్యాచులు ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు రాయండి.

question: When did ties in ODI World Cup matches take place? Mention the year, the two teams playing and the location of the match.
query: SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', match_date) AS INTEGER) AS year, team1, team2, city FROM Matches WHERE LOWER(result_type) LIKE '%tie%' ORDER BY year;
question_english: When did ties in ODI World Cup matches take place? Mention the year, the two teams playing and the location of the match.
question_hindi: ODI विश्व कप मैचों में टाई कब-कब हुए? वर्ष, खेलने वाली दोनों टीमों और मैच का स्थान बताएं।
question_punjabi: ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਟਾਈ ਕਦੋਂ-ਕਦੋਂ ਹੋਏ? ਸਾਲ, ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਚ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: ODI వరల్డ్ కప్పు మ్యాచులలో టై ఎప్పుడు జరిగినది? సంవత్సరం, ఆడే టిములు మరియు మ్యాచ్ యొక్క స్థానం రాయండి.

question: From the 2002 ODI World Cup onwards, what were the highest successful run chases? Mention the season, winning team, score, opponent and venue.
query: WITH innings_totals AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ) SELECT M.season, M.match_winner AS winning_team, I.total_runs AS chase_score, CASE WHEN M.match_winner = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, M.city FROM Matches M JOIN innings_totals I ON M.match_id = I.match_id AND I.batting_team = M.match_winner WHERE M.result_type = 'wickets' AND CAST(substr(M.season, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 ORDER BY chase_score DESC LIMIT 10;
question_english: From the 2002 ODI World Cup onwards, what were the highest successful run chases? Mention the season, winning team, score, opponent and venue.
question_hindi: 2002 के बाद के ODI विश्व कप में सबसे बड़े सफल रन चेज़ कौन से रहे? सीज़न, विजेता टीम, स्कोर, विपक्षी टीम और स्थान बताइए।
question_punjabi: 2002 ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੇ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਸਫਲ ਰਨ ਚੇਜ਼ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਰਹੇ? ਸੀਜ਼ਨ, ਜੇਤੂ ਟੀਮ, ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਦਾਨ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: 2002 తర్వాత జరిగిన ODI వరల్డ్ కప్పుల్లో అత్యంత విజయవంతమైన రన్ ఛేజ్‌లు ఏమిటి? సీజన్, గెలిచిన జట్టు, స్కోర్, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు మరియు వేదికను పేర్కొనండి.

question: From the 2002/03 ODI World Cup season onwards, who scored the most centuries in a single ODI World Cup edition? Mention the player name, season and number of centuries.
query: WITH innings AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season ) SELECT P.player_name, I.season, COUNT(*) AS centuries FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE I.runs >= 100 GROUP BY P.player_name, I.season ORDER BY centuries DESC LIMIT 10;
question_english: From the 2002/03 ODI World Cup season onwards, who scored the most centuries in a single ODI World Cup edition? Mention the player name, season and number of centuries.

question_punjabi: 2002/03 ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਤੋਂ, ਇੱਕ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸੈਂਚਰੀਆਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਬਣਾਈਆਂ? ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਂਚਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: 2002/03 ODI వరల్డ్ కప్ సీజన్ నుండి, ఒక ODI వరల్డ్ కప్ ఎడిషన్‌లో అత్యధిక శతకాలు చేసిన ఆటగాళ్లు ఎవరు? ఆటగాడి పేరు, సీజన్ మరియు శతకాల సంఖ్యను పేర్కొనండి.

question: Which players have the most 50+ scores in a World Cup while batting at No 5 or below? Mention the number of scores, the player and the season.
query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: Which players have the most 50+ scores in a World Cup while batting at No 5 or below? Mention the number of scores, the player and the season.
question_hindi: विश्व कप में नंबर 5 या उससे नीचे बल्लेबाजी करते हुए किन खिलाड़ियों ने सबसे अधिक 50+ स्कोर बनाए? स्कोर की संख्या, खिलाड़ी का नाम और सीज़न बताएं।
question_punjabi: ਨੰਬਰ 5 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦਿਆਂ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ 50+ ਸਕੋਰ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਹਨ? ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: ఏ క్రీడాకార్లు వరల్డ్ కప్పులో నెంబర్ 5 లేదా దానికన్నా తక్కువ స్థానంలో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసేదప్పుడు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ అర్ధ శతాబ్దాలు సంపాదించారు? అర్ధ శతాబ్దాల సంఖ్య, క్రీడాకార్లు మరియు సీజన్ రాయండి.

question: Which teams recorded the highest powerplay scores in ODI World Cup history after the 2002/03 season? Mention the team, season, opponent and powerplay runs.
query: SELECT D.batting_team AS team, M.season, CASE WHEN D.batting_team = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS powerplay_runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.over_number < 10 AND CAST(substr(M.season,1,4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ORDER BY powerplay_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
question_english: Which teams recorded the highest powerplay scores in ODI World Cup history after the 2002/03 season? Mention the team, season, opponent and powerplay runs.

question_punjabi: 2002/03 ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ powerplay ਸਕੋਰ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੇ ਬਣਾਏ? ਟੀਮ, ਸੀਜ਼ਨ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ powerplay ਰਨ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: 2002/03 ODI వరల్డ్ కప్ సీజన్ తర్వాత, ODI వరల్డ్ కప్ చరిత్రలో అత్యధిక పవర్‌ప్లే స్కోర్లు చేసిన జట్లులు ఏవి? జట్టు, సీజన్, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు మరియు పవర్‌ప్లే పరుగులను రాయండి.

question: Which players have the most wickets in powerplay 1 in the 2019 World Cup? Mention the player name and the number of wickets.

question_english: After Virat Kohli's record 2023/24 World Cup campaign, which players scored the second and third highest runs in a single ODI World Cup edition after the 2002/03 season? Mention the player name, season and total runs.

question: After JC Archer, MA Wood and CR Woakes, which England bowler recorded the fourth highest wicket tally in a single World Cup edition from 2003 onwards? Mention the player name, season and number of wickets.
query: WITH england_wickets AS (SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND D.bowling_team = 'England' GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season) SELECT player_name, season, wickets FROM england_wickets ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3;

question: Which team took the highest average number of balls to reach a fifty in the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the team and the average balls taken.
query: WITH cumulative AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, D.batting_team, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019'), milestone AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, batting_team, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) SELECT batting_team, ROUND(AVG(balls_to_50), 0) AS avg_balls_to_50 FROM milestone GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY avg_balls_to_50 DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which team took the highest average number of balls to reach a fifty in the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the team and the average balls taken.

question: In New Zealand's three matches before the 2019 ODI World Cup final, what were their powerplay scores? Mention the stage and the powerplay score.
query: WITH nz_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, match_date, stage FROM Matches WHERE season = '2019' AND stage != 'Final' AND (team1 = 'New Zealand' OR team2 = 'New Zealand') ORDER BY match_date DESC LIMIT 3 ), pp1_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN nz_matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'New Zealand' AND D.over_number < 10 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN M.stage = 'League' THEN 'Group' ELSE M.stage END AS stage, P.runs || '/' || P.wickets AS powerplay_score FROM pp1_scores P JOIN nz_matches M ON P.match_id = M.match_id ORDER BY M.match_date;
question_english: In New Zealand's three matches before the 2019 ODI World Cup final, what were their powerplay scores? Mention the stage and the powerplay score.

question: Which is the top instance of runs added after the fall of the fifth wicket in the second innings of an ODI World Cup match? Mention the season, teams, venue and runs added.
query: WITH second_inning AS ( SELECT D.match_id, M.season, M.team1, M.team2, M.city, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_total, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 ), fifth_wicket_score AS ( SELECT match_id, season, team1, team2, city, MIN(running_total) FILTER (WHERE wickets_fallen = 5) AS score_at_5, MAX(running_total) AS final_score FROM second_inning GROUP BY match_id ) SELECT season, team1, team2, city, (final_score - score_at_5) AS last_five_wickets_runs FROM fifth_wicket_score ORDER BY last_five_wickets_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which is the top instance of runs added after the fall of the fifth wicket in the second innings of an ODI World Cup match? Mention the season, teams, venue and runs added.

question: Which were Kane Williamson's two fastest half-centuries in the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the opponent, venue and balls taken.
query: WITH cumulative AS ( SELECT D.match_id, M.season, M.team1, M.team2, M.city, D.striker_id, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) - SUM(CASE WHEN D.runs_scored = 0 AND D.extra_runs = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS ball_count FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE P.player_name = 'KS Williamson' AND M.season = '2019' ), milestone AS ( SELECT match_id, city, CASE WHEN team1 = 'New Zealand' THEN team2 ELSE team1 END AS opponent, MIN(ball_count) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id ) SELECT opponent, city, balls_to_50 FROM milestone ORDER BY balls_to_50 ASC LIMIT 2;

question: What were Australia's death overs (41-50) scores when batting first in group-stage matches of the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the opponent, venue, runs and wickets lost.
query: WITH death_overs AS ( SELECT M.match_date, M.stage, CASE WHEN M.team1 = 'Australia' THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, M.city, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019' AND M.stage = 'Group' AND D.batting_team = 'Australia' AND D.inning = 1 AND D.over_number BETWEEN 40 AND 49 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT opponent, city, runs, wickets FROM death_overs ORDER BY match_date;

question: Which batsmen recorded the most 50-plus scores in a single ODI World Cup edition after 2002/03? Mention the player name, season and number of 50-plus scores.

question: Which players scored the most 50+ scores in the 2019 ODI World Cup?
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus FROM (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019' GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id HAVING runs >= 50) T JOIN Players P ON T.striker_id = P.player_id GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY fifty_plus DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the largest lower-order recovery in a successful run chase in ODI World Cup history (runs added after the fall of the fifth wicket)?
query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: What is the largest lower-order recovery in a successful run chase in ODI World Cup history (runs added after the fall of the fifth wicket)?

question: What is the highest partnership in a single innings in the 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup?
query: WITH pair_runs AS ( SELECT M.match_id, D.inning, CASE WHEN p1.player_name < p2.player_name THEN p1.player_name ELSE p2.player_name END AS partner_1, CASE WHEN p1.player_name < p2.player_name THEN p2.player_name ELSE p1.player_name END AS partner_2, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players p1 ON D.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON D.non_striker_id = p2.player_id WHERE M.season = '2023/24' GROUP BY M.match_id, D.inning, CASE WHEN p1.player_name < p2.player_name THEN p1.player_name ELSE p2.player_name END, CASE WHEN p1.player_name < p2.player_name THEN p2.player_name ELSE p1.player_name END ) SELECT partner_1, partner_2, partnership_runs FROM pair_runs ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: What is the highest partnership in a single innings in the 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup?

question: Who has two (or more) World Cup five-fors against an opponent?

question: What were AB de Villiers' batting stats in the 2015 ODI World Cup? Mention the number of matches played, innings, total runs, hundreds, average, and strike rate.
query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE P.player_name = 'AB de Villiers' AND M.season = '2014/15' GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hundreds, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(balls), 0), 2) AS sr FROM innings;

question: Which wicketkeeper scored the most runs in a single ODI World Cup edition? Show top 2 by runs.
query: WITH keepers AS (SELECT DISTINCT FD.fielder_id AS keeper_id FROM FielderDismissals FD JOIN Deliveries D ON FD.delivery_id = D.delivery_id WHERE D.wicket_type = 'stumped'), innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, I.season, SUM(I.runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT I.match_id) AS matches, ROUND(SUM(I.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(I.dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg FROM innings I JOIN keepers K ON I.striker_id = K.keeper_id JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id GROUP BY I.striker_id, I.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 2;

question: Which teams have the best win percentage in ODI World Cup history among teams that have played at least 20 matches? Show the top 5.

query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, SUM(I.runs) AS total_runs, SUM(I.balls) AS balls_faced, ROUND(SUM(I.runs)*100.0/SUM(I.balls),2) AS sr FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id GROUP BY I.striker_id,P.player_name HAVING SUM(I.runs) >= 1000 ORDER BY sr DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Who has the best career batting strike rate in ODI World Cup history among batters with at least 1000 runs? Show the top 5.
question_hindi: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में कम से कम 1000 रन बनाने वाले बल्लेबाजों में सर्वश्रेष्ठ करियर स्ट्राइक रेट किसका है? शीर्ष 5 दिखाइए।
question_punjabi: ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 1000 ਦੌੜਾਂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਕਰੀਅਰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਕਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੈ? ਟਾਪ 5 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
question_telugu: కనీసం 1000 పరుగులు చేసిన బ్యాట్స్‌మెన్‌లలో ODI ప్రపంచకప్ చరిత్రలో ఉత్తమ కెరీర్ బ్యాటింగ్ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఎవరిది? టాప్ 5 చూపించండి.

question: Which teams have appeared in the most ODI World Cup finals? Show the top 5.
query: WITH finals AS (SELECT team1 AS team FROM Matches WHERE stage='Final' UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team FROM Matches WHERE stage='Final') SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS finals_played FROM finals GROUP BY team ORDER BY finals_played DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Which teams have appeared in the most ODI World Cup finals? Show the top 5.
question_hindi: ODI विश्व कप के फाइनल में सबसे अधिक बार खेलने वाली टीमें कौन सी हैं? शीर्ष 5 दिखाइए।
question_punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਰ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਫਾਈਨਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਹਨ? ਟਾਪ 5 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
question_telugu: అత్యధిక సార్లు ODI ప్రపంచకప్ ఫైనల్స్‌లో ఆడిన జట్లు ఏవి? టాప్ 5 చూపించండి.

question: What were Trent Boult's bowling figures in the powerplay overs (overs 1-10) during New Zealand's 2015 World Cup quarter-final against West Indies?
query: SELECT P.player_name AS player, M.team1, M.team2, M.season, M.match_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wides=0 AND D.noballs=0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) AS runs_conceded, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE P.player_name='TA Boult' AND M.season='2014/15' AND M.team1='New Zealand' AND M.team2='West Indies' AND D.over_number<=9 GROUP BY D.bowler_id, D.match_id, P.player_name, M.team1, M.team2, M.season, M.match_date;
question_english: What were Trent Boult's bowling figures in the powerplay overs (overs 1-10) during New Zealand's 2015 World Cup quarter-final against West Indies?
question_hindi: 2015 के ODI विश्व कप के क्वार्टर फाइनल में वेस्ट इंडीज़ के खिलाफ पावरप्ले ओवरों (ओवर 1-10) के दौरान Trent Boult के गेंदबाजी आंकड़े क्या थे? इसमें फेंकी गई वैध गेंदों की संख्या, दिए गए रन और लिए गए विकेटों की संख्या बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਵੈਸਟਇੰਡੀਜ਼ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਨਿਊਜ਼ੀਲੈਂਡ ਦੇ 2015 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਕੁਆਰਟਰ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਵਰਪਲੇ ਓਵਰਾਂ (ਓਵਰ 1-10) ਦੌਰਾਨ Trent Boult ਦੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਕੀ ਸਨ?
question_telugu: వెస్టిండీస్‌తో న్యూజిలాండ్ 2015 ప్రపంచకప్ క్వార్టర్ ఫైనల్‌లో పవర్‌ప్లే ఓవర్లలో (ఓవర్లు 1-10) Trent Boult బౌలింగ్ గణాంకాలు ఏమిటి?

question: What were Glenn McGrath's bowling figures during his 7-wicket haul against Namibia in the 2003 ODI World Cup? Include number of legal balls thrown, runs conceded and wickets taken.
query: SELECT M.team1, M.team2, M.season, M.match_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wides=0 AND D.noballs=0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) AS runs_conceded, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE P.player_name = 'GD McGrath' AND M.season = '2002/03' AND M.team1 = 'Australia' AND M.team2 = 'Namibia' GROUP BY D.bowler_id, D.match_id;
question_english: What were Glenn McGrath's bowling figures during his 7-wicket haul against Namibia in the 2003 ODI World Cup? Include number of legal balls thrown, runs conceded and wickets taken.
question_hindi: 2003 के ODI विश्व कप में नामीबिया के खिलाफ Glenn McGrath के 7 विकेट वाले प्रदर्शन के गेंदबाजी आंकड़े क्या थे? इसमें फेंकी गई वैध गेंदों की संख्या, दिए गए रन और लिए गए विकेटों की संख्या बताइए।
question_punjabi: 2003 ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਮੀਬੀਆ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ Glenn McGrath ਦੇ 7 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਕੀ ਸਨ? ਸੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਵੈਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਦੌੜਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਲਈਆਂ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰੋ।
question_telugu: 2003 ODI ప్రపంచకప్‌లో నమీబియాపై Glenn McGrath 7 వికెట్లు తీసిన బౌలింగ్ గణాంకాలు ఏమిటి? వేసిన చట్టబద్ధమైన బంతుల సంఖ్య, ఇచ్చిన పరుగులు మరియు తీసుకున్న వికెట్లను చేర్చండి.

question: Who were the top scorers for India in their record 302-run win over Sri Lanka in the 2023 World Cup? Show the top 5.
query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls FROM Deliveries D WHERE D.match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season='2023/24' AND team1='India' AND team2='Sri Lanka') GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, I.runs, I.balls FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id ORDER BY I.runs DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Who were the top scorers for India in their record 302-run win over Sri Lanka in the 2023 World Cup? Show the top 5.
question_hindi: 2023 के ODI विश्व कप में श्रीलंका के खिलाफ भारत की रिकॉर्ड 302 रन की जीत में भारत के लिए सबसे अधिक रन बनाने वाले शीर्ष 5 बल्लेबाज कौन थे?
question_punjabi: 2023 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼੍ਰੀਲੰਕਾ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ 302 ਦੌੜਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਿੱਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਰਤ ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਦੌੜਾਂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੌਣ ਸਨ? ਟਾਪ 5 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
question_telugu: 2023 ప్రపంచకప్‌లో శ్రీలంకపై భారత్ రికార్డు 302 పరుగుల విజయంలో భారత్ తరపున అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన వారు ఎవరు? టాప్ 5 చూపించండి.

question: What were the team totals in each innings of the tied 2019 World Cup Final between England and New Zealand, including the Super Over? Include number of runs made and number of wickets fallen in each inning.
query: SELECT D.inning, D.batting_team, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D WHERE D.match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season='2019' AND stage='Final') GROUP BY D.inning, D.batting_team ORDER BY D.inning;
question_english: What were the team totals in each innings of the tied 2019 World Cup Final between England and New Zealand, including the Super Over? Include number of runs made and number of wickets fallen in each inning.
question_hindi: इंग्लैंड और न्यूज़ीलैंड के बीच खेले गए 2019 ODI विश्व कप फाइनल, जो टाई रहा था, की प्रत्येक पारी (सुपर ओवर सहित) में टीमों के कुल स्कोर क्या थे? इसमें प्रत्येक पारी में बनाए गए कुल रन और गिरे विकेटों की संख्या बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਇੰਗਲੈਂਡ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਊਜ਼ੀਲੈਂਡ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਟਾਈ ਹੋਏ 2019 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ, ਸੁਪਰ ਓਵਰ ਸਮੇਤ ਹਰ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ ਕੀ ਸਨ? ਹਰ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਣੀਆਂ ਦੌੜਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਡਿੱਗੀਆਂ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰੋ।
question_telugu: ఇంగ్లాండ్ మరియు న్యూజిలాండ్ మధ్య టై అయిన 2019 ప్రపంచకప్ ఫైనల్‌లో, సూపర్ ఓవర్‌తో సహా ప్రతి ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో జట్ల మొత్తం స్కోర్లు ఏమిటి? ప్రతి ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో చేసిన పరుగుల సంఖ్య మరియు పడిన వికెట్ల సంఖ్యను చేర్చండి.
